newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah steady in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah steady in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was lower but steady against the dollar in slow late trading on Wednesday despite jitters over the ongoing general election campaign, dealers said.

They said the rupiah was initially driven down on the spill-over effect from an attack on the Thai baht and false rumours about disturbances during electioneering by the minority United Development Party (PPP) increased the pressure.
There were no reports of any election-related violence in the country, although tens of thousands of PPP supporters were marching through parts of Jakarta.

One local bank dealer said ample liquidity, with overnight money falling to 5.0/6.0 percent at close, was another blow to the rupiah. Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,433.40/33.75 at 0930 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,430.0/31.5.
The rupiah touched a day-low of 2,434.5 at midday on Singapore selling which failed to sustain.
Dealers said the rupiah recovered slightly in the afternoon on worries of possible liquidity tightening on Friday for tax payments.
Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,433.00/33.35 and 2,431.5/32.0, respectively.
The local bank dealer said dollar short-covering by foreign players seemed to have also weakened the rupiah, and expected further coverings ahead of the weekend.
Overnight swap was at 0.40/0.45 and tom/next at 0.40/0.46.
One-month swaps were at 13.75/14.00, two at 26.00/27.00, three at 40.25/40.75 and six at 79.0/79.5 points.
The central bank kept its intervention band at 2,407/2,599 and the conversion band at 2,407/2,455 on Wednesday.
The bank raised its bands by one point on Tuesday after lowering them by one point each in the previous two trading days. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
